Sets a x264 preset profile. Only applies to videos rendered with `h264` codec.<br />Possible values: `superfast`, `veryfast`, `faster`, `fast`, `medium`, `slow`, `slower`, `veryslow`, `placebo`.<br />Default: `medium`

## CLI flag

Use `--x264-preset` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                    |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--x264-preset <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--x264-preset <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--x264-preset <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--x264-preset <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--x264-preset <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#x264preset)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#x264preset)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#x264preset)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#x264preset)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setX264Preset('fast');
```
